class: A store whose only writers are test fixtures: the write path (guards, revisions, history) is built and verified, and readers are built and verified against fixture rows, but no runnable job or command ever fills the store in a real environment, so every feature reading it is empty outside tests while each piece reports done. Wider shape: a consumer verified before its producer exists looks finished until the first real run.
mechanism: W-006/W-056/W-057 built and verified the catalogue store and apply_update (with the ADR-058/059 guards); the outcome route and the leg picker read the catalogue; but apply_update is called only from tests and a migration, so the real test database held 0 live contracts on 2026-10-10.

first_seen.evidence: core-proof query on ofo_test 2026-10-10 14:58 UTC: NIFTY not-expired option expiries = [] (0 live rows); grep of backend/, scripts/, tests_app/ for apply_update: only backend/ofo_app/catalogue_store.py (definition), alembic 0003, and 6 tests_app files. The same real list applied in a rolled-back transaction added 4,948 contracts in 2.5 s.

fix: Every store gets its production writer (a runnable command, then a scheduled job) in the same stage as its first reader; a work item that reads a store names the writer that fills it in a real environment and proves the read on data that writer loaded. W-068 adds the one-shot load command; the scheduled daily + intraday load is issue #126 and finding daily-load-misses-intraday-additions.

detection.note: No check yet compares stores read by app code with stores written by non-test code. Found by the prove-the-core-first step of W-068, not by a check.

occurrences.evidence: 0 live contracts in ofo_test; apply_update called only from tests
